newsitem.title: USA: Roland wins injunction vs Atmel, Cirrus.
newsitem.headline: Roland wins injunction vs Atmel, Cirrus.

text.p: Roland Corp said Monday it has won an injunction against Atmel Corp and Cirrus Logic Inc in its copyright suit alleging they infringed on its sound recordings.

The ruling from the U.S. District Court for the Central District of California is aimed at semiconductor makers Atmel, Atmel's French unit DREAM SA and Crystal Semiconductor Co, a Houston-based unit of Cirrus Logic Inc, Roland said.
Neither Atmel nor Cirrus could be reached immediately for comment.
Roland said its suit contends that the three infringed on the copyrighted sound recordings of musical instruments and sound effects contained in its Sound Canvas product line.
Roland said the injunction requires the defendants to stop the manufacture, distribution, sale and advertising of any product containing the copyrighted materials.
